extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin is designed for users of Granola AI who want to keep their synthesized meeting notes and raw transcripts together.
motivation: This plugin is designed for users of Granola AI who want to keep their synthesized meeting notes and raw transcripts together.
problem: Users of Granola AI need an automated way to keep their synthesized meeting notes and raw transcripts together within their Obsidian vault.
summary: A tool that merges Granola AI meeting notes and raw transcripts into unified Markdown files or copies them to the clipboard.
